summary: Bristol County, MA: a 1931 tower built on Great Meadow Hill was moved to Long Hill in 1955 at the Army's request; no recent condition or access report was found.

facts.design: 68-foot steel tower with a 10-by-10-foot wooden cab
facts.status_note: Register gives the Long Hill site and coordinates; no recent visit or condition report found
facts.agency: Mass. Bureau of Forest Fire Control

events.note: Register: original 28-foot steel tower on Richmond Hill; the former-site register gives a different origin (Dighton), see notes
Moved to Great Meadow Hill; 12-foot extension and spiral staircase added (register)
Register dates the present 68-foot tower to 1931; the former-site register (entry for Great Meadow Hill) says a new tower was built that year to replace the older one
New cab and two-way radios added
Army request; removed June 1955 and reconstructed on Long Hill about three miles south. State forest history says Reservoir Avenue instead
Registered December 15, 2004; nominated by Henry Isenberg

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the former-site register agree that a 68-foot tower was built in 1931 on Great Meadow Hill.

notes_for_editor: Unresolved: origin of the older tower (register: Richmond Hill, 28 ft, 1912; former-site register: Dighton, 50 ft, first operated 1916). Unresolved: the 1955 site (Long Hill per register and former-site register; Reservoir Avenue per Mass.gov state forest history). No visit report or access information found, so access is omitted. Facebook posts from the Massachusetts FFLA chapter describe the 1955 move to Long Hill, but they were search snippets only and are not cited.
